findings.actor: user B using a device previously used by user A
findings.input: user A has pending local expense rows and outbox mutations, then session changes
findings.mission: use offline expenses without seeing or replaying another account's data
findings.expected: local expenses and mutations are isolated by authenticated user and household
findings.actual: the singleton offline store had no account/household scope boundary
findings.rootCause: local expense and outbox records lacked a durable session scope key
findings.fix: added user-household scopes, quarantined legacy unscoped rows, scoped snapshots and flushes, and current-account purge
findings.verification: targeted tests, full mobile suite, release gate, and ten repeated critical runs passed
findings.residualRisk: the additive SQLite upgrade path was not exercised on an installed device because no device was connected

findings.input: edit an existing refund or support adjustment while offline
findings.mission: change details without converting the adjustment into a normal expense
findings.expected: refund/support kind and Report net totals remain correct
findings.actual: the offline payload/client update path only modeled expense and gift
findings.rootCause: expense kind was narrowed during conversion to the offline payload
findings.fix: preserved refund/support locally and omitted unsupported type rewrites so the server retains the existing adjustment kind
findings.verification: targeted tests, mobile typecheck, full mobile suite, and release gate passed

findings.input: published legal row with an HTTPS URL on a reserved/private/example host and no valid body
findings.mission: consent only after a real legal document is available
findings.expected: reserved/private document locations are invalid production legal content
findings.actual: any syntactically valid HTTPS URL could satisfy the current-document policy
findings.rootCause: URL validation checked protocol but not reserved/private host classes
findings.fix: rejected localhost, loopback/private ranges, reserved TLDs, and example domains
findings.verification: legal unit tests, legal/privacy E2E, full API suite, and release gate passed
findings.residualRisk: actual approved production legal documents remain externally blocked

findings.mission: run without test fixture identifiers or local-backend signatures
findings.expected: production bundle contains no local household/user fixture identifiers
findings.actual: the first Release 4E contamination run found local-household-daon
findings.rootCause: a new offline scope helper directly embedded standalone fixture identifiers
findings.fix: made scope resolution pure and injected fixture identifiers only through the production-replaced runtime boundary
findings.verification: production Hermes export scanner passed with zero findings

findings.mission: see a terminal retry state instead of retrying forever
findings.expected: automatic retry is finite and manual retry is explicit
findings.actual: automatic attempts had no terminal cap
findings.rootCause: backoff grew but state never transitioned to failed by attempt count
findings.fix: capped automatic retries at five and reset attempts only for manual retry
findings.verification: targeted and ten repeated sync tests passed

findings.input: successful mutation followed by home/report navigation
findings.mission: see updated totals and preparation state immediately
findings.expected: all affected query families are invalidated once
findings.actual: distributed invalidation omitted some Report V3 and preparation consumers
findings.rootCause: mutation callers duplicated incomplete cache-key lists
findings.fix: centralized financial and preparation invalidation contracts
findings.verification: targeted tests, full mobile suite, and release gate passed

findings.input: unknown or malicious runtime notification route
findings.expected: runtime values are allowlisted and unknown types fail safely
findings.actual: the navigation boundary trusted the client type
findings.rootCause: arbitrary received strings were not independently validated
findings.fix: added a runtime route allowlist with null fallback
findings.verification: targeted tests, full mobile suite, notification E2E, and release gate passed

findings.mission: see a consistent report without duplicate feature requests
findings.expected: aggregate endpoint is the production source of truth
findings.actual: legacy request conditions remained alongside aggregate loading
findings.rootCause: production and Pixel Lock request plans were not explicit
findings.fix: production initial load now uses Report V3 aggregate only; Pixel Lock keeps deterministic fixture reads
findings.verification: request-plan tests, full mobile suite, production export, and release gate passed
findings.residualRisk: installed populated-report tracing was not run because no device was connected
